description.en: Opens the Xiaoyingma AI video canvas in a DSH sidebar and dock tab; agents read and edit canvas nodes through the bundled yingma CLI. Requires a Xiaoyingma account. Published on npm as dsh-yingma-canvas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏和右侧停靠栏打开小影马 AI 视频无限画布；Agent 通过随包的 yingma CLI 读写画布节点。需要小影马账号。已发布到 npm，包名 dsh-yingma-canvas。
